decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper builds directly on the firm's long-standing construction machinery know-how and kept its own page in 2024, so the firm can interpret its market feedback and refine it.
The articulated construction dumper sits at the core of the firm's engineering experience and remained prominently presented, so it is a natural extension worth keeping.

Visibility fell from its own page to a mere mention, but the mine rescue vehicle draws on the firm's established underground vehicle competence and serves a niche with long sales cycles, so it is likely kept despite the weaker signal.
The compact telescopic loader line with several models fits the firm's lifting and construction expertise and is still presented on its own page.
The material lift line builds on a long-established rental favourite and has a large order as concrete evidence of demand, which shows strong related knowledge and market traction.
The compact mining loader leverages the firm's core underground competence, and the quantified field result of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months gives clear learning feedback for further improvement.
